content.title: Boston Marathon 2026: Emily Sisson finally takes her shot
content.text: Boston Marathon 2026: Emily Sisson finally takes her shot Skip to main contentBoston Marathon | Women's Elite PreviewAmerican record-holder, ex-Providence College star Emily Sisson finally taking on Boston MarathonBy Amin Touri Globe Staff,Updated April 6, 2026, 5:00 a.m. Print this Article View Comments3Emily Sisson finished second at the US Olympic marathon trials in 2024.Mike Ehrmann/GettyEmily Sisson’s road from Providence to Boston has been a little longer than the 50-mile drive up I-95.The American record-holder in the marathon, once a star in track and cross-country at Providence College, made her debut over 26.2 miles in London in 2019. Seven years later, she’s finally taking on the Boston Marathon for the first time.“I’ve always wanted to do it,“ Sisson told the Globe during a training trip to Boston in March. “Living in the Northeast for so long — I lived in Rhode Island for, like, eight or nine years — even just running the course today, I just feel like I’m running in New England. It feels nice.
